sections.text:
The Digital Fault Recording 
(DFR) system is a data collection and analysis instrument designed to record the 
fault and disturbance data on electrical power system. Analog quantities are 
recorded by the DFR data Acquisition unit (DAU), An individual DAU can monitor 
to (16) Analog channels and (32) event / digital channels, these input channels 
are continuously sampled and digitized so that when triggered. The instrument 
stores and prints a record of all the channels conditions before, during and 
after the trigger. The DAU accepts triggers from external equipment and up to 
six sensors installed in the DAU.

Introduction
The Digital Fault Recording 
(DFR) system is a data collection and analysis instrument designed to record the 
fault and disturbance data on electrical power system. Analog quantities are 
recorded by the DFR data Acquisition unit (DAU), An individual DAU can monitor 
to (16) Analog channels and (32) event / digital channels, these input channels 
are continuously sampled and digitized so that when triggered. The instrument 
stores and prints a record of all the channels conditions before, during and 
after the trigger. The DAU accepts triggers from external equipment and up to 
six sensors installed in the DAU.
